mapper.sql: id::text AS id, kind AS type, lane, status, payload::text AS payload_json, result::text AS result_json, error, priority, resource_key, parent_id::text AS parent_id, origin, attempt AS attempts, max_attempts, lease_owner, cancel_requested, progress_current, progress_total, progress_message, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM available_at) AS run_after, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM lease_until) AS lease_until, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM created_at) AS created_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM updated_at) AS updated_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM started_at) AS started_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM finished_at) AS finished_at
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND parent_id IS NULL GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM task_workers WHERE heartbeat_at > now() - interval '10 seconds'
SELECT FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
SELECT FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND parent_id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ORDER BY created_at ASC

INSERT INTO tasks(user_id, parent_id, kind, lane, status, dedupe_key, payload, origin, available_at) VALUES ( CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), CAST(#{parentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lane, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'queued', #{dedupeKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{payload, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb), COALESCE(#{origin, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'api'), now() ) ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) WHERE dedupe_key IS NOT NULL AND status IN ('queued', 'running', 'retry_wait', 'cancelling') DO NOTHING RETURNING

SELECT FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('queued', 'running', 'retry_wait', 'cancelling') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET status = CASE WHEN status IN ('queued', 'retry_wait') THEN 'cancelled' WHEN status IN ('running', 'cancelling') THEN 'cancelling' ELSE status END, cancel_requested = CASE WHEN status IN ('queued', 'retry_wait', 'running', 'cancelling') THEN true ELSE cancel_requested END, finished_at = CASE WHEN status IN ('queued', 'retry_wait') THEN now() ELSE finished_at END, updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

UPDATE tasks SET status = 'queued', attempt = 0, error = NULL, result = NULL, cancel_requested = false, available_at = now(), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, heartbeat_at = NULL, started_at = NULL, finished_at = NULL, progress_current = 0, progress_total = 0, progress_message = '', updated_at = now() WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND status IN ('failed', 'cancelled')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_events(task_id, event_type, payload) VALUES (CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{type, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CAST(#{payload, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(e.id) FROM task_events e JOIN tasks t ON t.id = e.task_id WHERE t.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

SELECT e.id, e.task_id::text AS job_id, e.event_type AS type, e.payload::text AS payload_json, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM e.created_at) AS created_at FROM task_events e JOIN tasks t ON t.id = e.task_id WHERE t.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND e.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: WITH RECURSIVE candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND status IN ('cancelled', 'succeeded', 'failed') AND COALESCE(finished_at, updated_at) < to_timestamp(#{cutoffEpoch}) AND id NOT IN ( SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND status IN ('cancelled', 'succeeded', 'failed') ORDER BY COALESCE(finished_at, updated_at) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{keepRecent} ) ), protected_ids(id) AS ( SELECT DISTINCT child.parent_id FROM tasks child WHERE child.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND child.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidates c WHERE c.id = child.id) UNION SELECT parent.parent_id FROM tasks parent JOIN protected_ids protected ON protected.id = parent.id WHERE parent.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND parent.parent_id IS NOT NULL ), deletable AS ( SELECT c.id FROM candidates c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM protected_ids p WHERE p.id = c.id) ) DELETE FROM tasks task USING deletable WHERE task.id = deletable.id AND task.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

WITH RECURSIVE active_chain(id, parent_id, path) AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, ARRAY[id] FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND status IN ('queued', 'running', 'retry_wait', 'cancelling') UNION ALL SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id, active_chain.path || parent.id FROM tasks parent JOIN active_chain ON parent.id = active_chain.parent_id WHERE parent.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND NOT (parent.id = ANY(active_chain.path)) ), deletable AS ( SELECT task.id FROM tasks task WHERE task.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND task.status IN ('cancelled', 'succeeded', 'failed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_chain WHERE active_chain.id = task.id) ) DELETE FROM tasks task USING deletable WHERE task.id = deletable.id AND task.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

WITH RECURSIVE descendants(id, parent_id, status, path) AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, status, ARRAY[id] FROM tasks WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND id = CAST(#{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND status IN ('cancelled', 'succeeded', 'failed') UNION ALL SELECT child.id, child.parent_id, child.status, descendants.path || child.id FROM tasks child JOIN descendants ON child.parent_id = descendants.id WHERE child.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND NOT (child.id = ANY(descendants.path)) ), active_descendants AS ( SELECT 1 FROM descendants WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running', 'retry_wait', 'cancelling') LIMIT 1 ), deletable AS ( SELECT id FROM descendants WHERE status IN ('cancelled', 'succeeded', 'failed') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_descendants) ) DELETE FROM tasks task USING deletable WHERE task.id = deletable.id AND task.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
